info.what: The value does not fit what is known about the customer.
info.when: Use it when sums are out of line with income, turnover or past activity.
info.mistake: Flagging a large amount without comparing it with the profile.

info.what: The number or timing of payments is unusual.
info.when: Use it for bursts, repeated similar payments or funds that move on quickly.
info.mistake: Ignoring normal cycles such as wages or seasonal trade.

info.what: The other party to a payment raises a question.
info.when: Use it when a payer or payee has no clear link to the customer's stated activity.
info.mistake: Treating an unfamiliar name as suspicious in itself.

info.what: A location does not fit, or carries higher risk.
info.when: Use it when a country or branch location has no clear business reason.
info.mistake: Flagging a country without checking the purpose of the payment.

info.what: A document is missing, weak or contradicts other facts.
info.when: Use it when the paperwork does not support what the customer says.
info.mistake: Accepting a document without comparing it with the transactions.

info.what: The way someone acts raises a question.
info.when: Use it for evasive answers, unusual use of the account or third parties acting for the customer.
info.mistake: Relying on impressions instead of recorded facts.

info.what: Control or ownership is unclear or hidden.
info.when: Use it when beneficial owners, nominees or connected companies need explaining.
info.mistake: Stopping at the first company in the chain.

info.what: Cash split into smaller deposits.
info.when: Choose it when deposits appear arranged to avoid attention.
info.mistake: Calling every regular cash deposit structuring.

info.what: An account used to pass on funds for someone else.
info.when: Choose it when unrelated credits leave quickly and the account holder gains little.
info.mistake: Overlooking mules who may not understand what they are doing.

typologies.label: Proceeds of authorised push payment fraud

info.what: Funds a victim was deceived into sending.
info.when: Choose it when credits look like payments obtained by deception.
info.mistake: Looking only at the account that first received the funds.

info.what: A company with little real activity or unclear control.
info.when: Choose it when the structure seems to exist mainly to move funds.
info.mistake: Treating every holding company as a shell.

typologies.label: Politically exposed person with unexplained wealth

info.what: Wealth that does not fit a public role.
info.when: Choose it when source of wealth cannot be supported.
info.mistake: Assuming that PEP status alone is suspicious.

info.what: Crypto converted into money in the banking system.
info.when: Choose it when the source of the crypto cannot be explained.
info.mistake: Treating any exchange payment as suspicious.

info.what: A real business used to explain cash from elsewhere.
info.when: Choose it when cash cannot be reconciled with the business's capacity.
info.mistake: Comparing cash only with the declared turnover.

info.what: Funds moved under the cover of trade.
info.when: Choose it when goods, prices or routes do not make commercial sense.
info.mistake: Reviewing the payment without reviewing the goods.

info.what: A one-off credit from selling property.
info.when: Choose it when completion papers support the funds.
info.mistake: Accepting the explanation without the paperwork.

info.what: Funds received from an estate.
info.when: Choose it when probate or estate papers support the funds.
info.mistake: Not checking who actually paid the money.

info.what: A business that earns most of its income in certain months.
info.when: Choose it when peaks match the declared season and records.
info.mistake: Comparing a peak month with an annual average.

info.what: An occasional payment from work or shareholdings.
info.when: Choose it when the payer and amount can be confirmed.
info.mistake: Assuming the payment is genuine because it is labelled that way.

info.what: Regular support sent to relatives.
info.when: Choose it when amounts and recipients fit the customer's circumstances.
info.mistake: Not noticing when recipients or amounts change.

info.what: Profit from crypto that can be traced.
info.when: Choose it when exchange records support the purchase and the sale.
info.mistake: Accepting a screenshot in place of a full history.

requestDocument.what: Asks for a document that is not yet on file.
requestDocument.when: Request it when the document could change your view of the case.
requestDocument.mistake: Requesting everything. Each request uses time from your shift.
